name: dsh-file-history
description: DeepSeek Harness static plugin: snapshot-before-write file history — every `write`/`edit` that would overwrite an existing file is copied into the project's .dsh-backup/ first (filename + timestamp, last N generations kept), with a `file_history` tool to list, diff and restore, plus a top-bar status chip panel for observation.
author: cuteG41cute
